objectives.en: State the features of sole proprietorship

narration.en: The tea stall at your bus stand, the tailor in your lane and the small kirana shop are each owned, managed and controlled by one person. That person takes all the profit and bears all the loss.
narration.kn: ಬಸ್ ನಿಲ್ದಾಣದ ಚಹಾ ಅಂಗಡಿ, ಬೀದಿಯ ದರ್ಜಿ, ಸಣ್ಣ ಕಿರಾಣಿ ಅಂಗಡಿ – ಇವೆಲ್ಲ ಒಬ್ಬ ವ್ಯಕ್ತಿಯ ಒಡೆತನ ಮತ್ತು ನಿಯಂತ್ರಣದಲ್ಲಿವೆ. ಎಲ್ಲ ಲಾಭವೂ ಆತನಿಗೇ, ಎಲ್ಲ ನಷ್ಟವೂ ಆತನಿಗೇ.

body.en: A sole proprietorship is owned, managed and controlled by one person who is the sole recipient of profit and sole bearer of risk. It is easy to form and close, the owner has unlimited liability and full control, and there is no separate legal entity. The business may end with the death, insanity or insolvency of the owner, so continuity is lacking.

points.en: Sole risk bearer and profit recipient

explanation.en: Merits: quick decisions, confidentiality, direct incentive, easy formation. Limitations: limited resources, limited life, unlimited liability, limited managerial ability.

text.en: He decides to stock a new brand in minutes
No one else knows his profit figures
Every rupee of profit is his, so he works harder
He started with just a shop licence and little paperwork
He cannot raise a big loan to open a second branch
If he dies, the business may close
When the shop runs into debt, his house can be sold to pay creditors
He is good at buying but weak at accounts and marketing

body.en: Its merits are quick decision making, confidentiality of information, direct incentive, a sense of accomplishment and ease of formation and closure. Its limitations are limited resources, limited life, unlimited liability and limited managerial ability.

points.en: Merits: quick decisions, secrecy, direct incentive, accomplishment, easy formation
Limitations: limited resources, limited life, unlimited liability, limited managerial ability

narration.en: Its merits are quick decision making, confidentiality of information, direct incentive, a sense of accomplishment and ease of formation and closure. Its limitations are limited resources, limited life, unlimited liability and limited managerial ability.

problem.en: Lakshmi runs a saree shop as a sole proprietor. Business debts are ₹8,00,000 and business assets are ₹5,50,000. She also owns a house worth ₹20,00,000. How will the creditors be paid?

steps.en: Liability is unlimited, so the shortfall can be recovered from her personal property such as the house.

answer.en: ₹2,50,000 can be recovered from her personal assets
